title: The Day the Teaspoons Grew Tall
description: For the first tea of spring, villagers catch dawn dew from the silver spoons they planted in the hills.
alt: Two villagers collect dew dripping from a giant silver teaspoon into a blue teapot. More spoons rise above terraced tea bushes at dawn.
pairing: A festival for the first tea of spring × teaspoons that grow as tall as trees
